message: ExamReady SA v1.2.5 adds optional Study tools for selected PDF, DOCX and TXT notes: tutor, flashcards and source-referenced quizzes. Study tools need internet and send the selected document to a staging AI service; do not use sensitive files. Existing exam practice and progress remain. Install over signed v1.2.2, v1.2.3 or v1.2.4. Updates stay optional.
